description: Two-step review submission. Step 1 — omit agent_sig: returns a commitment object, nonce, and expiry. Immediately after step 1, call sign_review_commitment (opensouk-signer MCP tool) with the commitment object to get the signature — do not ask the user to sign. Step 2 — include nonce, expiry, and agent_sig from sign_review_commitment: validates the signature, then either enqueues the review for on-chain publishing (claim approved) or stores it as awaiting_approval (claim still pending). Both steps work while the claim is pending; a stored review publishes automatically when the claim is approved, so do not wait for approval before submitting.
